import json
import re
import sys
import zipfile

from packaging.version import InvalidVersion, Version


def canon(name):
    return re.sub(r"[-_.]+", "-", name).lower()


def load(path):
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    recs = {}
    for n in sorted(z.namelist()):
        if n.endswith(".json"):
            recs[n[:-5]] = json.loads(z.read(n))
    return recs


def valid(v):
    try:
        Version(v)
        return True
    except InvalidVersion:
        return False


def pypi_affected(rec):
    out = []
    for i, a in enumerate(rec.get("affected", [])):
        p = a.get("package", {})
        if p.get("ecosystem") == "PyPI":
            out.append((i, p.get("name", ""), a))
    return out


def groups(recs):
    """union-find over id + aliases of non-withdrawn records; never `related`."""
    parent = {}

    def find(x):
        parent.setdefault(x, x)
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x

    def union(a, b):
        ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
        if ra != rb:
            parent[max(ra, rb)] = min(ra, rb)

    live = {k: r for k, r in recs.items() if "withdrawn" not in r}
    for k, r in live.items():
        find(r["id"])
        for al in r.get("aliases", []):
            union(r["id"], al)
    members = {}
    for k, r in live.items():
        members.setdefault(find(r["id"]), []).append(k)
    return live, members


def is_malicious(live, member_ids):
    for k in member_ids:
        r = live[k]
        names = [r["id"]] + list(r.get("aliases", []))
        if any(n.startswith("MAL-") for n in names):
            return True
        if "CWE-506" in (r.get("database_specific") or {}).get("cwe_ids", []):
            return True
    return False


def rep(live, member_ids):
    names = set()
    for k in member_ids:
        names.add(live[k]["id"])
        names.update(live[k].get("aliases", []))
    ghsa = sorted(n for n in names if n.startswith("GHSA-"))
    return ghsa[0] if ghsa else sorted(names)[0]


def rec_signal(r):
    ns = [r["id"]] + list(r.get("aliases", []))
    if any(n.startswith("MAL-") for n in ns):
        return True
    return "CWE-506" in (r.get("database_specific") or {}).get("cwe_ids", [])


def main(path):
    recs = load(path)
    live, members = groups(recs)
    gid_of = {}
    for gid, mem in members.items():
        for k in mem:
            gid_of[k] = gid
    print("records with summary starting 'Malicious code in' (non-withdrawn):", sum(1 for r in live.values() if (r.get("summary") or "").startswith("Malicious code in")))
    print("... of which no record-level structural signal:")
    n = 0
    for k in sorted(live):
        r = live[k]
        if (r.get("summary") or "").startswith("Malicious code in") and not rec_signal(r):
            n += 1
            gid = gid_of[k]
            mem = sorted(members[gid])
            print("  RECORD", k, "| aliases", r.get("aliases"), "| group", rep(live, mem), "members", mem,
                  "| group_malicious", is_malicious(live, mem))
    print("count", n)
    print("distinct groups among them", len({gid_of[k] for k in live if (live[k].get("summary") or "").startswith("Malicious code in") and not rec_signal(live[k])}))
    print("mixed groups (malicious + non-malicious records):")
    for gid, mem in sorted(members.items()):
        flags = {rec_signal(live[k]) for k in mem}
        if len(flags) == 2:
            print("  ", rep(live, sorted(mem)), [(k, rec_signal(live[k])) for k in sorted(mem)])


main(sys.argv[1])
